close_reason: TryFrom<Certificate> now moves subject and spki from owned cert
description: The TryFrom<Certificate> impl calls cert.tbs_certificate.subject.clone() and cert.tbs_certificate.subject_public_key_info.clone() even though it owns cert. These should be direct moves to avoid two unnecessary heap allocations. The maintenance consequence: this pattern will be copy-pasted if anyone adds similar converters, spreading the inefficiency.
title: TryFrom<Certificate> unnecessarily clones owned fields
